description: The chart illustrates token counts as a function of the “Number of Shots,” with each bar showing a stacked breakdown into “Reasoning” and “Demonstration” tokens. The horizontal axis contains the shot categories labeled 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 in ascending order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Token Count” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000 with regularly spaced tick marks at 1000-token intervals. Each category is represented by a stacked vertical bar with a brown base segment labeled in the legend as “Reasoning” and a blue top segment labeled “Demonstration.” At 0 shots, there is a single brown bar (no blue segment visible) reaching 6393 tokens, with the value “6393” printed above it and a dashed horizontal reference line at the same height. At 1 shot, the brown reasoning segment rises to roughly 4200 tokens and a small blue demonstration segment brings the total to about 4450 tokens; a red downward arrow annotation above the bar shows “-1952.” At 2 shots, the brown segment is around 4500 tokens with a blue segment extending the total to roughly 4750 tokens, annotated with a red “-1613” arrow. At 3 shots, the brown segment reaches about 5000 tokens and the blue segment increases the total to approximately 5350 tokens, annotated “-1040” in red above. At 4 shots, the brown segment is near 4250 tokens with a larger blue segment bringing the total to about 5000 tokens, annotated with a red “-1379” arrow. The bars are not visually sorted by height beyond the natural left-to-right ordering of shot count, and the red arrow annotations and the dashed reference line provide additional visual emphasis without changing bar styling.
